senses.gloss: settlement, inhabited land, opp. מדבר or ים; cultivation, social world, civilization; public welfare.
units: <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 1:15:1">Koh. R. to I, 15</cite>; Ruth. R. to I, 17 <he>אם אין אדם מתקן ביי׳ וכ׳</he> if man does not prepare provision in the inhabited settlement (this world), what will he have to eat in the desert (the hereafter)?—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Kamma 5:8:3">Y. B. Kam. V, end, 5ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="A00577"><he>אָוָוז</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 58b:1">Ib. 58ᵇ</cite> <he>הרואה בתי … ביִשּׁוּבָן</he> he who sees Israelitish places in their inhabitable condition (restoration), opp. <he>בחורבנן</he>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 58b:4">Ib.</cite> <he>עתיד הקב״ה להחזירו ליִשּׁוּבוֹ</he> the Lord will restore it again.

<cite ref="Tamid 29b:27">Tam. 29ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Kamma 80b:15">B. Kam. 80ᵇ</cite> <he>משום י׳ א״י</he> in order to maintain the cultivation of Palestine. Y. B. Bath. II, end, 13ᶜ <he>י׳ עולם בבורות</he> social welfare depends on wells; <he>באילנות</he> on trees.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kiddushin 1:10">Kidd. I, 10</cite> <he>אינו מן הי׳</he> does not belong to the civilized world.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 35:3">Gen. R. s. 35</cite> <he>בני אדם של י׳</he> civilized (polite) people; a. fr.

senses.gloss: (with or without דעת) ease of mind, calmness.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 19:5">Gen. R. s. 19</cite> <he>בי׳ הדעת באת עליו</he> she came to him with deliberation (logical arguments).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 1:1:14">Y. Ned. I, 36ᵈ</cite> bot.; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10:7">Num. R. s. 10</cite> <he>מתיך י׳</he> (<he>הדעת</he>) in a calm state of mind, opp. <cite ref="A02935"><he>אקפדה</he></cite>; a. fr.
